name: VCSL Kenyan Kalimba
description: A Kenyan mbira/kalimba recorded for the VCSL CC0 library, with eleven pitched tines across B2–B4 and alternate takes for repeated tines.

license.author: Versilian Studios LLC (VCSL; individual performer not identified)
license.notes: Pinned VCSL source c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e. VCSL is licensed CC0-1.0 by Versilian Studios LLC; the repository does not identify the individual performer. The folder is called Kalimba, Kenya; the recordings are labelled Mbira6. Pitches are taken from the file-name note labels. Repeated tine labels (B3, D#3, F#3, G#3) remain alternate takes rather than separate notes.
